# Code Of Conduct

MLVM project spaces are for technical collaboration. Participants must:

- communicate respectfully and address the work rather than the person;
- accept technical disagreement without harassment or retaliation;
- give actionable feedback and allow reasonable mistakes to be corrected;
- respect privacy, attribution, licensing, and coordinated vulnerability disclosure;
- avoid discriminatory, threatening, sexually explicit, or deliberately disruptive conduct.

This applies to issues, pull requests, reviews, discussions, project events, and private
communication made in a project role.

Report conduct problems privately to the repository owner through their GitHub profile. Do
not use a public issue when doing so would expose a target or sensitive information. The
maintainer may edit or remove content, close discussions, restrict participation, or ban an
account when necessary to protect the project and its contributors.

Enforcement decisions should consider context, impact, repeated behavior, and the safety of
affected participants. Good-faith technical criticism is allowed; personal abuse is not.
